definitions.gloss: product lineup, assortment, selection of goods
definitions.explanation: The range and variety of products available at a store or business. Used to evaluate or describe how well-stocked or diverse a shop's offerings are.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{品揃|しなぞろ}えがいい。
examples.english: This store has a good selection.

examples.japanese: {品揃|しなぞろ}えが{豊富|ほうふ}なスーパーが{近所|きんじょ}にある。
examples.english: There's a supermarket with a wide selection near my house.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}ごとに{品揃|しなぞろ}えを{変|か}えることで、{客|きゃく}を{飽|あ}きさせない{工夫|くふう}をしている。
examples.english: By changing the product lineup with each season, they keep customers from getting bored.

notes:
A compound of {品|しな} (goods) + {揃|そろ}える (to arrange, to prepare). Commonly used when talking about shopping and retail. The quality of a store's {品揃|しなぞろ}え is a key factor in consumer reviews.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{品揃|しなぞろ}えがいい — to have a good selection
・{品揃|しなぞろ}えが{豊富|ほうふ} — to have a rich assortment
・{品揃|しなぞろ}えを{充実|じゅうじつ}させる — to enrich the product lineup
・{品揃|しなぞろ}えが{悪|わる}い — to have a poor selection
